comment: The powers of two are a ripple counter (DivideConquer.cpp:171-202). The odd divisions are modelled as flip-flop chains rather than counted (DivideConquer.cpp:99-160), which is why the half divisions change state on the clock's falling edge; the 3/2 and 7/2 outputs are taken from the inverted side of their flip-flop (DivideConquer.cpp:218, 224) while 5/2 is not.
